items.title: DeepMind以AI代理驗證Signal加密實作安全性，數學證明擴及機器碼層級
items.summary: Google DeepMind公布AI代理形式化驗證（Formal Verification）框架AlphaProof Code，利用AI代理驗證Signal加密通訊協定的核心程式庫libsignal，將安全性證明延伸到編譯後的機器碼。Signal協定廣泛應用於通訊服務，此次5名DeepMind研究人員與AI代理合作，4周內產出約650萬行以Lean語言撰寫的數學證明程式碼，驗證前向保密性（Forward Secrecy，FS）、身分驗證及入侵後安全性恢復等要求。

items.title: fix(tlon): inbound messages lose their list contents (#197057)
items.summary: fix(tlon): inbound messages lose their list contents (#197057) fix(tlon): keep native list content in inbound messages The Tlon text extractor had no case for native lists or task lists, so a message that was only a list came out empty and was dropped by both the DM and group paths, and a mixed message reached the agent without its list. The extractor now renders unordered, ordered and task lists, including nesting and checked state, as plain text, within the existing depth and size limits. No text changes. Evidence: a built Gateway with the Tlon channel in a secretless node:24.22.1 container, a local ship stand-in sending real Tlon story payloads to groups and DMs, and a stand-in model recording its input, two runs each. On main a group list-only message, DM unordered, nested ordered and task lists were all dropped, and a group message with text plus a nested ordered list arrived as text only; with this change each list arrives with its items, nesting and checked state. Plain mentions, quotes, plain DMs, code-only mentions, a 600-level nested list and an over-limit payload behave the same on both. One compact regression fails on main, at -7 net test lines. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197057#issuecomment-6809239522. Closes #197056. Thanks @Jo2234. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(oc-path): resolve dotfiles and consecutive-dot filenames (#197398)
items.summary: fix(oc-path): resolve dotfiles and consecutive-dot filenames (#197398) fix(oc-path): accept hidden and double-dot filenames in unquoted oc:// addresses The oc:// address parser rejected unquoted file segments that start with a dot or contain two dots in a row, such as .settings.json and notes..json, with OC_PATH_EMPTY_SUB_SEGMENT, even though openclaw path find returns those addresses unquoted. Those valid filenames now parse. Traversal rules are unchanged: a .. segment, a bare . segment, absolute paths, empty segments and empty dotted keys are still rejected with the same error codes. No text changes. Evidence: the built CLI in a secretless node:24.22.1 container with the oc-path plugin enabled. path find on .settings.json and notes..json returned unquoted addresses; main rejected each with OC_PATH_EMPTY_SUB_SEGMENT (exit 2), and this change resolves each to the right value. oc://../x, oc://sub/../config.json, quoted parent and absolute paths, a bare absolute path, an empty segment, an empty dotted key and oc://./key are rejected identically on both, and quoted forms and ordinary names resolve unchanged. The security and limits tests only gain blocked cases, at -1 net test lines. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197398#issuecomment-6809133500. Thanks @LinzeShi. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
